report.summary: Patient P-D008 (Darnell Whitaker, DOB 1985-02-19), Medicaid-covered, age 41. Social-needs screener (2026-10-12) shows no current food insecurity (food worry and food ran out both "never_true"), but food resource options were requested. Four community food resources were identified near the patient's home tract (17031400800, Chicago IL 60637). Harvest Table Pantry offers an instant eligibility check; a check was submitted using name, DOB, Medicaid ID, and address, but only a generic "received / we will contact you" response was returned, so eligibility is not yet confirmed. No-ID pantry, community fridge, and Cook County-resident pantry options are also available without an eligibility submission.
